Parsing all-digit values with epoch_ms and casting the rest as before resolves this without changing the output schema.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.8, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT txn_id, customer_id, merchant_id, amount, txn_ts, CAST(txn_ts AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM (SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CASE WHEN regexp_matches(txn_ts, '^[0-9]+$') THEN CAST(epoch_ms(CAST(txn_ts AS BIGINT)) AS TIMESTAMP) ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS txn_ts FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED') t;"}}
